authority: proposed source-bound decomposition only; no original graph or production declaration modified

active_unlinked_purge_member.proposition: Exactly one active node migrates to purge; parent ownership unchanged; no free.

allocated_parent_unresolved.proposition: Allocated parent remains outstanding on explicit data-null edge unless independently proved infeasible.

allocation_extent.proposition: Allocation arithmetic, alignment and MK_THREAD_DATA extent agree; failure/data-null alternatives retained.

allocation_failed.proposition: mk_thread_new returns NULL, producing no new owner.

borrowed_chain_live.proposition: Session, channel and event survive through reset; destruction releases none of these borrowed objects.

callback_checked_parent_callee_params_re.proposition: Free/clear params, unlink/reset, explicit callback, callee delete, parent free; borrowed objects survive.

callback_checked_parent_callee_retired.proposition: No params; explicit callback after reset and before callee/parent retirement; independent footprint evidence required.

callback_dispatch_closure.proposition: Library callback code/data/request/session lifetime and all transitive effects separately established; plugin dispatch remains FIXME, allocation/event failures retained.

callback_footprint.proposition: Every optional cb_destroy and transitive effect has independently established returning trace preserving parent, callee, borrowed chain, complete list/saved-successor footprint until enclosing destruction; no neutral/circular assumption.

callee_live.proposition: Libco callee is initialized, live, compatible with co_delete and not running.

cleanup.proposition: Proposed admission of bounded safe-list iteration, counting once per completed destroy.

coroutine_creation_failed.proposition: co_create NULL after insertion/request assignment; source proceeds to params/switch unchecked. No successful creation or rollback inferred.

create.proposition: Proposed admission of source creation including every early-return and unchecked coroutine outcome; finite cleanup checker does not validate creation.

created.proposition: Valid parent/embedded data/callee, params initialized, initialization context switch returns; all dependent effects established independently.

creation_no_new_owner.proposition: Allocation failure creates no cleanup duty; pre-existing caller resources survive.

creation_unchanged.proposition: Missing scheduler creates no owner and edits no list/request.

data_null.proposition: Explicit MK_THREAD_DATA NULL test returns NULL after parent allocation without source free; reachability under defined layout remains Open.

destroy.proposition: Proposed admission of params free/clear, unlink, event reset, optional callback, callee delete and parent free in source order.

empty_list.proposition: No selected member and no destroy call; nonnull params TLS remains untouched.

environment.proposition: Exact seven pinned source files, correct ABI/layout/libco/TLS configuration; finite sequential model, no extraction/deployment proof.

exact_parent_embedding.proposition: Node is _head of the HTTP object embedded in exactly one live sufficiently large parent allocation; parent field identifies it.

invalid_membership.proposition: Positive absent/duplicate/wrong-list/stale membership forbids admission; source has no complete membership guard.

linked_owner_with_unresolved_switch.proposition: Linked parent and request alias exist before unchecked callee failure; attempted switch effects and termination Open.

linked_parent_and_borrowed_request.proposition: Parent owns embedded HTTP object/callee; request/session/handler data borrowed; active list gains one node, conditional on creation prerequisites.

missing_purge_scheduler.proposition: Purge scheduler lookup NULL returns -1 before close/list edit.

missing_scheduler.proposition: Create scheduler lookup NULL before parent allocation.

moved_to_purge.proposition: Same-owner scheduler found, close assigned, node unlinked then inserted in purge list; zero return.

no_concurrent_writer.proposition: No concurrent list, coroutine, borrowed-chain or TLS mutation.

no_later_alias_use.proposition: All external aliases, request->thread and channel.thread are retired or never read/resumed after parent free. Source does not clear them.

nonempty_list.proposition: One or more admitted suspended members destroyed once in original safe-iteration order.

original_lists_unchanged.proposition: Missing-scheduler purge leaves lists, close and ownership unchanged.

original_state_unchanged.proposition: Empty cleanup has no modeled effects, return count zero, no params free.

parent_callee_params_retired_borrows_liv.proposition: Free/clear params, unlink, event reset, callee delete, parent free; borrowed objects survive.

parent_callee_retired_borrows_live.proposition: Unlink, event reset, callee delete, parent free; borrowed objects survive; no params existed.

parent_live.proposition: Parent allocation has exclusive release authority and is neither borrowed nor already freed.

purge.proposition: Proposed admission of close assignment and active-to-purge migration; no ownership release.

request_live.proposition: Request/session and writable fields remain live on every path reaching their uses.

retiring_current_tls.proposition: Current mk_thread TLS aliases retiring parent; bounded consumer refuses because source never clears it. Broader rebind protocol requires proof.

selected_list_empty_and_borrows_live.proposition: Selected parents/callees retired once; other list/borrowed chain survive; events reset; count matches original length; params freed at most once.

suspended_coroutines.proposition: Every retiring coroutine is suspended, not co_active; no concurrent resume, destruction or re-entry.

tls_absent_callback_absent.proposition: Explicit destroy branch: tls absent callback absent. Presence/absence positive; callback effects independently required.

tls_absent_callback_present.proposition: Explicit destroy branch: tls absent callback present. Presence/absence positive; callback effects independently required.

tls_api_success.proposition: TLS initialization/get/set configuration established; ignored pthread key/set return values must succeed, not inferred from source binding.

tls_params_owned.proposition: Params TLS is NULL or independently allocated live releasable storage, disjoint from owned/borrowed/callback resources.

tls_present_callback_absent.proposition: Explicit destroy branch: tls present callback absent. Presence/absence positive; callback effects independently required.

tls_present_callback_present.proposition: Explicit destroy branch: tls present callback present. Presence/absence positive; callback effects independently required.

valid_membership.proposition: Valid circular sentinels, reciprocal links, distinct live embedded nodes, exact disjoint membership and valid saved successor.

worker_tls.proposition: Current OS thread owns selected scheduler; worker TLS identifies it. Current-thread TLS is absent or a live modeled parent token, never a callee/params/borrowed allocation token. Cleanup itself ignores sched.

lifecycle_metadata.creation: |^+ introduces resource/hypothesis metadata; no allocation fact follows
lifecycle_metadata.retirement: |^- retires resource/hypothesis metadata; no C free/global negation follows
